request: Add rounds to all edges of the part. R=0,2mm

actions.target: All edges of the part (external perimeter edges + pocket opening edges + internal pocket edges + cradle/pad boundary edges + roof end-flat edges)
actions.relational_constraint: Apply uniformly to all edges; maintain symmetry about X=0 and Y=0 by selecting full edge-chains/feature-wide edge sets rather than single-edge picks.
actions.unresolved_reference: No explicit edge list is provided in model.json; edges must be derived as intersections of the faces listed below. If the CAD fillet fails on specific vertices (multi-edge junctions around the cradle ends/pocket roof end flats), apply the same 0.2 mm fillet in multiple sub-operations over smaller edge sets until all edges are rounded.
steps: Create a new Fillet/Round feature (constant radius) with radius = 0.2 mm.

Primary selection (preferred): Use global selection for the entire solid body: Select > Edge filter > Select All Edges (entire part), enable tangent propagation/chain where the system supports it. This should capture: (a) external edges from the outer perimeter frame S1 (faces 0001/0003 with ends 0002/0004 and bottom rim 0000), (b) pocket opening perimeter edges between S1 bottom rim plane 0000 and pocket walls S3 (0011–0014), (c) internal pocket top edges where pocket walls S3 (0011–0014) meet the roof underside faces S2 (0008/0009/0010), and (d) top-side cradle boundary edges where the concave cradle cylinder S2 (0006) meets the top pads S2 (0005, 0007) and any adjacent planar faces of S1 at the outer ends.
If the single all-edges fillet fails, suppress/rollback and apply the same 0.2 mm fillet in the following robust order (multiple fillet features allowed, all at R=0.2 mm):

Fillet Feature A (internal pocket opening): Select the edge loop(s) at the pocket opening where bottom rim plane S1:0000 meets pocket walls S3:0011,0012,0013,0014 (perimeter rectangular loop). Apply 0.2 mm.

Fillet Feature B (internal pocket/roof junction): Select edge loop(s) where pocket walls S3:0011–0014 meet underside roof end flats S2:0008 and S2:0010 and underside cylindrical shell S2:0009. Apply 0.2 mm with tangent propagation on the cylindrical edge chains.

Fillet Feature C (external perimeter): Select all external box edges formed by S1 outer faces 0001/0003 with end faces 0002/0004, and their intersections with the top surface regions (including where S1 meets S2 at the top perimeter). Apply 0.2 mm.

Fillet Feature D (cradle termination edges): Select the edge chains at the transitions between top concave cradle cylinder S2:0006 and top end pads S2:0005 and S2:0007 (and any remaining sharp edges around the top end pad perimeters). Apply 0.2 mm.

Regenerate/compute the model; visually inspect all views (top, bottom, isometric) to confirm there are no remaining sharp edges on external, pocket, and roof/cradle terminations. Ensure the fillet radius remains 0.2 mm on every successfully rounded edge and that symmetry is preserved by selecting complete mirrored edge sets.
